title: Code Mode: The Other Half Your Agent Hasn't Built
headline: Anthropic cut one workflow from 150,000 to 2,000 tokens with Code Mode.
description:
Operator: give this to your agent. Anthropic, Cloudflare, Perplexity, and Hornet converge on one move: stop handing the model raw tool schemas, expose a typed API, and let it write code against it. Anthropic reports a 98.7% token cut on one workflow. This report maps the pattern onto a real CLI-first, 129-skill dispatch loop, confirms where it already runs Code Mode's orchestrator half, and names two gaps: unmanaged intermediate-result bloat and a retrieval skill with no programmable primitives.
